text:
```yaml
name: Link Checker

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC

jobs:
  link-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run lychee
        uses: lychee-action/lychee-action@v1
        with:
          args: --config lychee.toml
```
